resources.string: Enable Developer options: open Settings > About phone and tap \"Build number\" 7 times.
Open Settings > System > Developer options, find \"Select mock location app\" and choose FakeGPS.
Move the map so the red target sits on the place you want to fake.
Move the map and press Add point
You arrived at the final point. Fake GPS keeps running at this location until you stop it.

Single location mode: tap the green play button to fake that spot. Route mode: move the map so the pin is where you want a waypoint, press Add point, repeat, pick a speed, then press play to walk the route; the app keeps faking at the final point until you tap stop. Tap the ? button to see this guide again.
